newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 200 METRES CHAMPION PINTUSSEVICH.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-PROFILE OF WORLD 200 METRES CHAMPION PINTUSSEVICH.

text.p: Profile of Zhanna Pintussevich, winner of the world women's 200 metres title on Friday.
Has completed an outstanding championships after winning the silver medal in the 100 metres at the weekend.
Won the silver in the Europrean 200 in Helsinki in 1994. Before that her major claim to fame was that she held the world indoor record 50 metres of 6.09 for a few minutes in 1993.
Married to hurdler Igor Pintussevich, who was third in the world junior 110 metres hurdles in 1992.
